weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference (2026-10-23)

detail.act_accumulated_value: the growth equation dA/dt = delta A integrated by scipy DOP853
detail.act_buhlmann_straub: the same estimators from expanded sums of squares and numpy weighted averages
detail.act_central_death_rate: the defining ratio m = (integral of tp mu)/(integral of tp) by scipy quad, re-solved for q by brentq
detail.act_commutation_functions: D and C are definitions; N and M recomputed from backward insurance and annuity recursions
detail.act_compound_distribution_moments: the variance through E[S^2] = E[N]E[X^2] + E[N(N-1)]E[X]^2
detail.act_deferred_death_probability: the product of survival ratios over the deferment and the interval
detail.act_expected_claims_method: the same definitions by numpy vector arithmetic
detail.act_exponential_mle: lifelines' ExponentialFitter agrees only to its optimizer's tolerance (checked to 1e-4); the compared value is the root of the likelihood score by brentq
detail.act_force_of_interest: the accumulation factor exp(integral of delta) by scipy quad
detail.act_fractional_age: the hazard of each assumption (sympy) integrated by scipy quad; the force at x+s is the same derivative
detail.act_interest_rate_conversion: the nominal rates re-solved from their defining equations by brentq; d, v and delta are definitions
detail.act_life_table_functions: the same definitions by numpy differences and ratios
detail.act_loan_amortization: the payment re-solved by brentq on a year-by-year balance roll-forward; the schedule simulated
detail.act_loss_ratio_rate_change: the pure premium form of the same indication in exact fractions
detail.act_nominal_to_effective_rate: the same definition evaluated through the force of interest (log1p/expm1)
detail.act_partial_credibility: the same rule by numpy clipping, the estimate written as M + Z (xbar - M)
detail.act_policy_value_recursion: the same recursion equation solved for the end-of-year value by sympy
detail.act_premium_principles: the same definitions in exact sympy arithmetic
detail.act_present_value_cash_flows: the same sum by numpy dot products in exponential form
detail.act_pure_endowment: the product of one-year survival ratios discounted
detail.act_pure_premium_rate: the same definitions in exact fractions
detail.act_single_loss_payment: the same definition by numpy clipping
detail.act_survival_probability: the product of one-year survival ratios
detail.act_woolhouse_approximation: the same published approximation evaluated in exact sympy arithmetic
